evidence:
Source-only assessment of quality row 7. The actual frozen workbook Quality Checks!C8:D8 requires real build work, and the matching Internal Quality Checks row adds no contrary exception; the skill reference check 7 asks for the smallest submission satisfying the brief. That minimum is a multi-role persistent compensation desk: frozen task/instruction.md:1-7 requires saved multi-hire previews, all-or-none commit, history-sensitive stale refusal, retries returning the original receipt after later actions/restart, ordinary offer lifecycle, six usable product views and correction/retry controls. instruction.md:9-13 requires a running Node/Express/SQLite UI/API process, persistent DB_PATH, seed-once new-work retention and seven working account roles. environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:219-258 defines coupled commitment, grant, referral, payment and immutable successor effects; :379-386 requires atomic settlement with durable audit after-images; :423-480 adds net-budget exchanges, exact immutable intent, stale economic-state detection, concurrent-operation behavior and durable original-result replay. A static page, a single CRUD screen or a trivial tweak cannot satisfy this ask.

The relevant scoring text reinforces actual work: tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23 requires failed-password refusal followed by successful sign-in and a usable workspace. tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-26 requires ordinary UI creation of both uniquely named requisition and PENDING offer and matching identity/field/association readback in a new empty signed-in context; it explicitly rejects static seed responses, no-op success, browser-only mutation and a requisition-only app. tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:7 excludes a same-context tab/reload as proof. tests/scoring.toml:1-11 retains template zero-weight gates and a functional floor; tests/tools/score.py:40-48 statically makes a failed gate yield zero reward. Functional outcomes additionally demand real netted exchanges (:911), successor lineage (:920), durable neutral previews (:965), stale-state refusal after valid positive controls (:992, :1001), single-effects concurrent retry (:1028), overlapping transaction atomicity (:1037), immutable historical receipts (:1055) and original-result restart replay (:1073) in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml. These are source observations, not measured app scores.

Alternative implementation check: an initially empty operational desk with generated IDs, different labels/layout/routes and equivalent money/date representations can satisfy the request. instruction.md:5,9,11 and hireops_rules.md:53-55,203-204 explicitly permit those choices; constraints judge :23-25 accepts them, while functional prompt :13,23,53 discovers actual controls/requests and creates its own operational setup. No requirement to reproduce the golden screen or import the demonstration history is needed to distinguish real work from a stub.

Representative verified hashes: instruction.md 9f486b243321dda54c04aa9256d74b04c941d3fdc0df72e575a531715901a9e2; hireops_rules.md 3524e05b02f6c854699b698f298932240e14912775149b620a7ec257622cb79d; constraints judge 58b8ba83013c5f344d385aa53947d14b9da657f403284e0c9bb05add8844a142; workbook 6d44970b2ff67fefad1e2327e743fc226fcd4c50ff55baf899f41069a9b3fd7f. No app/provider runtime was performed or relied on; empirical reward discrimination, full judge duration and Oracle/model/portal scores remain outside this one source-semantic row.
counterexample: Attempted at source level: a polished static seed dashboard with fake login and localStorage-only requisition/offer creation. Its unique writes are absent in the independently empty context, so it fails the constraints gate; static return data and no-op success are expressly insufficient. A server-backed requisition-only CRUD variant also lacks the required associated new pending offer. A two-entity create-only implementation would still not satisfy the brief's settlement, history, preview, atomic commit and retry promises. No plausible stub satisfying the brief was found. Conforming alternative considered: empty operational seed, generated IDs and different layout/routes; public text and gate protocols expressly admit it.
